result.summary: Rejects rollback requests in `dumptxoutset` when block or undo data is unavailable at the active tip, returning a pruning error instead of crashing. It uses `GetPruneHeight` to check data availability before attempting the rollback on pruned nodes that loaded an assumeutxo snapshot.
result.problem: When a pruned node loads a UTXO snapshot, its active tip can lack block and undo data. Attempting to roll back the UTXO set using `dumptxoutset` then triggers an assertion failure and terminates the node.
evidence: PR description: "Loading a UTXO snapshot on a pruned node can leave the active tip without block or undo data. Attempting a rollback with `dumptxoutset` then triggers an assertion and terminates the node."
result.card: Prevents a node crash when calling dumptxoutset rollback on a pruned node that loaded an assumeutxo snapshot. Without block or undo data at the snapshot tip, attempting a rollback triggers an assertion failure and terminates bitcoind. The PR checks data availability with GetPruneHeight and returns standard pruning RPC errors instead.
uncertainties: The diff was not provided, though the commit messages and description are consistent and concise.

risk.why: A faulty check could reject valid dumptxoutset rollback requests or fail to catch missing undo data before an assertion failure.
